author: cellish
body:
Hi there!
I made a new map that was quite hard for me actually due to that i learned a couple of new commands and stuff and i also tried some other stuff but that didn't work out very well because you were'nt able to use command blocks... 
And a thanks to {tag=32f9750efe564f7aaa981573efdc4dc2} who came and helped me at the end ;) Btw, if you look at the pictures it might feel like the map has very much op stuff, thats maybe right, but you cant have diamond armor at least and you cant enchant anything so you're at least going to have a pretty big chance of dying.
Anyways hope you like it!

Players: 15v15 - 20v20.
Gamemode: DTM.
XML: [COMING SOON]
Kill Rewards: 1 Gapple + the stuff the person you killed had on themselves except tools and armor + 2 xp bottles so you can combine with the enchanting books, otherwise they're useless lel.
Teams: Artemis vs Ares (nothing special with the loadout)
Images: http://imgur.com/a/us4Ux
Download: [COMING SOON]

replies.author: AbusiveUser
replies.body: Looks very flat; adding more detail in the islands may be good, and I honestly think you always put overpowered things in the chests like Fire Aspect books, Potions, bows with Power II or even the Sharpness 2 sword, we have talked about that in your maps like Daisy or Atlantis and we think you should remove those swords. So I suggest you to remove some of them IMO to prevent the farm kills.<br id="null"><br id="null">Also, take in mind what {tag=3902b25efd6544a78b55be7652694f39} said.<br id="null"><br id="null">Good luck in your map.<br id="null">
replies.body_tagged:
Looks very flat; adding more detail in the islands may be good, and I honestly think you always put overpowered things in the chests like Fire Aspect books, Potions, bows with Power II or even the Sharpness 2 sword, we have talked about that in your maps like Daisy or Atlantis and we think you should remove those swords. So I suggest you to remove some of them IMO to prevent the farm kills.

Also, take in mind what xNemoII said.

Good luck in your map.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We regret to inform you that your map will not be added. We have declined it for the following reasons:

- It is too simple
- There needs to be more structures
- Needs more elevation
- Needs more shape to the islands
- Too similiar to a lot of other maps
- Too flat
- Not unique enough, needs more content

If changes are made, you may repost your map with the requests above, and reply to this comment. We will then reevaluate it for further action on whether or not it will be accepted.

Thank you very much for submitting!
